snippet.title: Nowhere | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Nowhere is a nordic detective horror game, you play a detective trapped in the forests of Norway while searching for a group of missing tourists when you become trapped by the curse of the valley and must uncover the tragedies inside to escape.

Please check it out and wishlist! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743260/Nowhere/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
